/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-3f.description: Our 3 ft Curve Slide is a low red and yellow slide that bends to one side as the child comes down, with a short steel ladder at the back. The gentle turn adds a little excitement without much speed, which suits the youngest children in a nursery, play school or society toddler corner. A 3 ft height also lets parents and teachers reach the child at the top without climbing. The curve sends children out at an angle, so you can tuck the exit away from a walkway. Our standard warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts against manufacturing defects. Tell us the age of the children who will use it and we will confirm the right height.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-3f.spec_paragraph: The steel ladder and supports are galvanised, and the slide bed is made from weather-proof, corrosion-resistant material. It can be set up self-standing or grouted in. Leave clear ground at the exit where the curve releases children, and check the ladder steps and slide joints during maintenance.
flags: No spec rows (age group, capacity, product area, safe play area) and no warranty line in the fact sheet. This applies to every slide in this group.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-3f.description: Two lanes side by side make the 3 ft Double Wave Slide a favourite for small children who like to slide with a friend. Each lane rises and dips in a wave, so the ride has two gentle bumps on the way down. The slide is Play Red and climbs from a steel ladder at the back. At 3 ft high it is sized for younger children, and the double lane lets two go at once, which keeps the queue short at a busy play school or society garden. The ladder's galvanised pipe and the moulded lanes fall under our 3-year warranty for manufacturing defects. Ask us for a layout drawing that shows the slide and its exit zone.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-3f.spec_paragraph: A galvanised steel ladder leads up to the twin-lane slide bed. Our team installs it self-standing or by grouting, depending on the base. Two children leave the slide at the same time, so keep the exit area wide and clear, and inspect both lanes and the ladder during routine maintenance.
flags: No spec rows and no warranty line in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-3f.description: The Shrimp Slide is a low red slide shaped like a curled shrimp, reached by a short steel ladder. Its shape gives a toddler area a playful character piece that children recognise at once. At 3 ft high it suits the youngest group of children, who can climb the ladder and slide down without needing an adult to lift them. Themed slides like this work well in play schools, society toddler corners and resort kids' areas where looks matter as much as play. The colour is Play Red. Like our other slides, it has a 3-year warranty on galvanised and roto-moulded parts. Share a photo of your toddler area and we will suggest where it fits.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-3f.spec_paragraph: The shrimp body is moulded and the ladder is galvanised steel, so it handles sun and rain. We fix it self-standing or grouted. Lay an impact-absorbing surface at the foot of the slide, and check the ladder fixings and slide surface for cracks during maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-3f.description: The 3 ft Straight Open Slide is the simplest slide in our range: a straight red and yellow chute with a steel ladder at the back and an open top. There are no turns or bumps, so the ride is predictable, which helps nervous first-time sliders build confidence. Its low height makes it a sensible first slide for a nursery or kindergarten. Teachers can see the child the whole way down, and it fits against a wall or fence because it runs in a straight line. If a manufacturing defect shows up in the steel or moulded parts within 3 years, our warranty covers it. Send us your site size and we will mark the slide and its run-out on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-3f.spec_paragraph: This slide pairs a galvanised steel ladder with a weather-proof slide bed. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Plan a clear run-out zone at the foot of the slide, keep a soft surface there, and check the ladder rungs and the slide edges for wear during regular maintenance.
flags: No spec rows and no warranty line in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.description: At 5 ft high, this Curve Slide gives children a longer, faster ride than our 3 ft version while staying manageable for a primary school or society garden. The red and yellow slide bends to one side on the way down, and children climb up by a steel ladder. The curve means the exit points away from the ladder, which helps you plan the slide into a corner of the play area. A 5 ft slide sits in the middle of our height range, so it suits mixed groups of younger and older children. We warranty its galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts for 3 years when installed and maintained as we advise. Ask us whether a taller slide would suit your children better.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.spec_paragraph: The ladder and supports are galvanised steel and the curved bed is a weather-proof moulding. We grout it into the ground or set it on a self-standing base. Keep an impact-absorbing surface at the foot and beside the ladder, and inspect the joints and steps during maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.description: The 5 ft Double Wave Slide has two red lanes running side by side, each with a wave profile, and a wide steel ladder so two children can climb together. Racing a friend down the twin lanes is half the fun. The added height over our 3 ft model gives the waves more lift, so the ride suits children who have outgrown toddler slides. Two lanes also help on a busy school ground or society garden, since twice as many children get a turn. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts are covered by our standard 3-year warranty. Tell us how many children use your play area and we will advise on slide size.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.spec_paragraph: A wide galvanised ladder serves both lanes. We fix it self-standing or grout it, as the ground requires. Two children exit together, so plan a broad landing zone with rubber flooring and keep it clear of benches. Check both lanes, the ladder and all fixings at each maintenance visit.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.description: The S Slide turns twice on the way down, first one way and then the other, in a red S-shaped chute fed by a steel ladder. Those two turns make a 5 ft slide feel longer than a straight one, and children enjoy being swung from side to side. Its shape also gives the slide a distinct outline that stands out in a society garden or park. Because the exit ends up offset from the ladder, it can be fitted into an L-shaped corner of your site. The colour is Play Red. Our standard 3-year warranty applies to galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts. Send us your site plan and we will show the S Slide on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.spec_paragraph: The steel ladder is galvanised and the S-shaped bed is a weather-resistant moulding. Depending on the ground, our installers grout it or leave it self-standing. Allow for the full S-shaped footprint when planning your layout, keep a soft surface at the exit, and check the slide joints at each bend during maintenance.
flags: No spec rows and no warranty line in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.description: A spiral slide takes up less floor space than a straight one of the same height, because the chute wraps around itself. Our 5 ft Spiral Slide does exactly that, with a red open spiral and a steel ladder. Children go round in a full turn before they reach the bottom, which feels fast and exciting without being high. That compact footprint makes it a good option for a society garden or school courtyard where space is tight. The colour is Play Red. The 3-year warranty on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts applies here too. Share the size of your space and we will check whether the spiral fits.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.spec_paragraph: The spiral bed is moulded and the ladder and supports are galvanised steel. We install it self-standing or grouted. The exit faces a different direction from the ladder, so mark both on your layout, keep an impact-absorbing surface at the foot, and inspect the spiral joints during maintenance.
flags: No spec rows and no warranty line in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.description: The 5 ft Spiral Tunnel Slide is a red and yellow enclosed tube that spirals down from a steel tower. Children climb the tower, step into the tunnel and disappear from view for a moment before they come out at the bottom. The enclosed tube keeps children inside the slide all the way round, and the hidden ride is a big draw for the 5 ft age group. It needs less ground than a straight tunnel slide, so it suits compact play areas in schools and societies. The tower and tube come with a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Ask us for a layout drawing showing the tower, tunnel and exit.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.spec_paragraph: The tower is galvanised steel and the spiral tunnel is a weather-proof moulding. It can stand on its own base or be grouted in. Adults cannot see inside the tube, so place the exit where supervisors can watch it, keep a soft surface there, and check the tunnel joints during maintenance.
flags: No spec rows and no warranty line in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.description: Our 5 ft Straight Tunnel Slide runs a red and yellow enclosed tube straight down from a steel tower. It gives children the thrill of a tunnel without the turns of a spiral, so the ride is quick and direct. The closed tube means children cannot slip over the side on the way down. A straight run is easier to fit along the edge of a garden or school ground than a spiral, and supervisors can see the tower and the exit from one spot. Both the tower pipes and the tunnel mouldings are under warranty for 3 years. Send us your site measurements and we will place it on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.spec_paragraph: A galvanised steel tower supports the moulded tunnel sections. Installation is self-standing or grouted, chosen to suit the ground. Keep the exit clear and laid with rubber flooring, check the tunnel joints and tower steps at each maintenance visit, and clear any leaves or water from inside the tube after rain.
flags: No spec rows and no warranty line in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.description: The Wave Slide is a single red lane that rises and dips as it comes down from a 5 ft steel ladder. The waves slow the child slightly at each bump and then speed them up again, which makes a short slide feel livelier. It is a single-lane version of our Double Wave Slide, so it fits a smaller space or a lower budget. Schools often use a wave slide alongside a swing or climber to give children a quick ride between other activities. The colour is Play Red. Our standard warranty covers galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts for 3 years. Ask us for a quote and a layout drawing for your play area.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.spec_paragraph: The wave-profile bed is moulded and the ladder is galvanised steel. Our team fixes it self-standing or by grouting. Keep a soft surface at the foot of the slide, and check the slide bed for cracks and the ladder for loose fittings during regular maintenance.
flags: No spec rows and no warranty line in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.description: The Zig Zag Slide changes direction more than once on its way down, with sharp turns in a red and yellow chute that starts at a 5 ft steel ladder. Children are pushed from side to side at each turn, which gives a lively ride for its height. The zig zag shape also catches the eye in a society garden or park. Because the slide doubles back, it takes less length than a straight slide with the same drop. That helps on a narrow site. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry our standard 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Tell us about your site and we will mark the slide on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/slide-5f.spec_paragraph: Its galvanised steel ladder feeds a moulded zig zag bed. It goes in self-standing or grouted. Keep a clear landing zone at the exit, use an impact-absorbing surface under the slide, and check each turn and joint for cracks or gaps during routine maintenance.
